title: Piecewise Journey Speed Problem
subject: Mathematics
topic: Three‑segment speed scenario vs. two‑segment scenario
caption: Three‑segment vs. two‑segment journey showing a 4‑minute time difference and total distance 240 km.
altText: Diagram illustrating a journey of total distance D split into three equal parts of 80 km each, traveled at speeds 60 km/h, 50 km/h, and 40 km/h (top line). Below, the same total distance is split into two equal parts of 120 km each, traveled at speeds 60 km/h and 40 km/h. Time for each segment is shown, and a vertical arrow between the two total times indicates a 4‑minute difference. Solving the equation yields D = 240 km.
